text: {"lessons":["I sold several positions at gains, but a gain versus my cost basis does not mean a stock is now a better sell; I should judge each trade by its prospective risk and return.","Treating each stock as a separate account can make me cling to losers and sell winners too soon. Cost basis is useful for tracking, not a reason to hold or sell.","Past price changes do not predict future moves, so I should avoid reacting to short-term fluctuations and keep diversification and the portfolio’s overall risk in view."]}
